name: Michael
summary: Hanu-Man's villain: a superhero-obsessed rich kid turned fake gadget vigilante, 'Mega Man', who will do anything to get real powers. Played by Vinay Rai (2024).
origin: As a boy in Saurashtra in 1998, Michael was obsessed with superheroes. After he failed to fly, his parents told him heroes aren't real, and he killed them in a fire. As an adult in Mumbai he poses as the gadget-armed vigilante Mega Man, helped by his friend Siri, while secretly searching for genuine superpowers. When he hears about Hanumanthu's strength, he comes to Anjanadri pretending to run a corporate social-responsibility project, but his real goal is the gem.
powers: Wealth and a band of mercenaries

storyline.title: A dark origin
storyline.beat: Told that superheroes are fiction, young Michael murders his parents.

storyline.title: The fake hero
storyline.beat: As Mega Man he plays vigilante with gadgets while he hunts for real powers.

storyline.title: The CSR disguise
storyline.beat: He arrives claiming to do charity work and has Siri kidnap Hanumanthu to learn his secret.

storyline.title: Fire and gas
storyline.beat: Michael leaves Siri to die in a fire and releases a neurotoxic gas to paralyse the villagers.

storyline.title: Helicopter crash
storyline.beat: He steals the gem and tries to escape by helicopter, but Hanumanthu destroys it and Michael dies in the blast.

gossip.text: Director Prasanth Varma said Vinay Rai's suit was so hard to wear that the actor lost two kilograms during the shoot.
Tamil actor Vinay Rai was announced as the villain in June 2022.
Mega Man in Hanu-Man is a hero.
gossip.truth: The Mega Man persona is a front. Michael is the film's main villain.

gossip.text: He betrays even his only friend, leaving Siri for dead in a fire.

quiz.q: What vigilante name does Michael use?
quiz.why: He calls himself Mega Man and relies on gadgets.
Tamil actor Vinay Rai played the villain.

theme.tagline: Bought the suit, built the drones, never found a soul.

timeline.title: Vinay Rai's Mega Man
timeline.note: Vinay Rai plays a gadget-powered fake hero who will do anything to get real superpowers.

timeline.title: Hunting the gem
timeline.note: Michael poses as a charity worker and gasses the whole village to get his hands on the gem.

timeline.title: Helicopter crash
timeline.note: His getaway helicopter goes down in flames and takes him with it.

timeline.title: Award-winning brawls
timeline.note: The stunt team behind his fights with Hanumanthu wins Best Stunt Choreography at the 71st National Film Awards.
